summary: Cycurion, Inc. (Buyer) filed an 8-K reporting completion of its acquisition of the video-solutions division of Kustom Entertainment, Inc. (Seller) under an Asset Purchase Agreement dated June 24, 2026, amended July 23, 2026. Consideration includes $1,250,000 cash, a $4,250,000 secured promissory note, up to $1,000,000 earnout, and Series H Preferred Stock with $600,000 stated value (replacing 2,000,000 warrants). The preferred stock accrues 12% dividends and converts at $1.45 per share. The deal closed August 3, 2026. Watch for integration execution and earnout achievement; no risk-arb as it's completed.
